stem: 一家大型国际金融机构在美国和欧盟均有业务。一笔涉及一位拥有美国和法国双重国籍的高净值客户的跨境交易因其中介机构位于高风险地区而引发担忧。鉴于该交易受美国《银行保密法》（BSA）和美国海外资产控制办公室（OFAC）的要求，以及欧盟《第六号反洗钱指令》（6AMLD）和欧洲银行管理局（EBA）法规的约束，合规团队应采取何种最佳措施来确保合规？

options.A: 仅遵循欧盟法规,因为受益人位于法国
options.B: 实施一种同时满足美国和欧盟AFC规定的双重合规方法
options.C: 遵从最严格的监管制度以简化合规流程
options.D: 仅遵循美国法规,因为交易起源于美国

stem_en: A large international financial institution has operations in both the United States and the European Union. A cross-border transaction involving a high-net-worth customer with dual U.S. and French citizenship raises concerns because its intermediary institution is located in a high-risk jurisdiction. Given that the transaction is subject to the requirements of the U.S. Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), the U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), the EU Sixth Anti-Money Laundering Directive (6AMLD), and European Banking Authority (EBA) regulations, what is the best action the compliance team should take to ensure compliance?

options_en.A: Follow only EU regulations because the beneficiary is located in France
options_en.B: Implement a dual compliance approach that satisfies both U.S. and EU AFC requirements
options_en.C: Follow the strictest regulatory regime to simplify the compliance process
options_en.D: Follow only U.S. regulations because the transaction originated in the United States
